description: AlphaFold pLDDT, burial and backbone geometry around the PPPY motif in four Drosophila CG42404 orthologs
code:
import requests, re, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/6811dc4d-ddff-4159-9963-5139baa317dd/provenance"

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
     'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}

def load_af(acc):
    j=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=120).json()[0]
    pdb=requests.get(j["pdbUrl"],timeout=300).text
    ca={}; seqd={}; allat={}
    for l in pdb.split("\n"):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        ri=int(l[22:26]); rn=l[17:20]
        allat.setdefault(ri,[]).append((float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
        if l[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            ca[ri]=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]))
            seqd[ri]=AA3.get(rn,"X")
    return pdb, ca, "".join(seqd[i] for i in sorted(seqd)), allat

rows=[]
profiles={}
for acc,sp in [("B4QZ29","D. simulans"),("B3P0S9","D. erecta"),("B4HDZ6","D. sechellia"),("B4GLA8","D. persimilis")]:
    pdb,ca,s,allat = load_af(acc)
    m=re.search(r"PP.Y",s)
    if not m: print(acc,"no PPxY in model"); continue
    y = m.start()+4            # 1-based position of the Tyr
    n = len(s)
    pl = np.array([ca[i][3] for i in sorted(ca)])
    xyz = np.array([ca[i][:3] for i in sorted(ca)])
    # burial proxy: number of CA within 10 A (excluding +/-4 in sequence)
    d = np.linalg.norm(xyz[:,None,:]-xyz[None,:,:],axis=-1)
    idx=np.arange(n)
    mask = np.abs(idx[:,None]-idx[None,:])>4
    nb = ((d<10)&mask).sum(1)
    # i,i+4 CA distance: ~6.2 A in alpha helix, >9 A in extended/coil
    d4 = np.array([np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[i+4]) if i+4<n else np.nan for i in range(n)])
    core = slice(y-4, y)       # PPPY residues, 0-based
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc, species=sp, model_len=n, PPxY_pos=y-3,
        plddt_PPPY=round(float(pl[core].mean()),1),
        plddt_whole=round(float(pl.mean()),1),
        plddt_pct_of_protein=round(100*float((pl<pl[core].mean()).mean()),1),
        neighbours10A_PPPY=round(float(nb[core].mean()),1),
        neighbours10A_median=round(float(np.median(nb)),1),
        burial_percentile=round(100*float((nb<nb[core].mean()).mean()),1),
        CA_i_i4_PPPY=round(float(np.nanmean(d4[y-5:y])),2)))
    profiles[sp]=(pl, y)

df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv(f"{OUT}/cg42404_ortholog_alphafold_PPPY.csv",index=False)
print("\nReference: alpha-helix CA(i)-CA(i+4) ~ 6.2 A; extended/coil/PPII > 9 A.")
print("Lower neighbour count = more exposed. Lower pLDDT = less confidently folded.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4))
for sp,(pl,y) in profiles.items():
    w=range(max(0,y-45),min(len(pl),y+45))
    ax.plot([i-(y-4) for i in w],[pl[i] for i in w],lw=1.4,label=f"{sp} (n={len(pl)} aa model)")
ax.axvspan(0,3,color="#E45756",alpha=.25)
ax.text(1.5,96,"PPPY",ha="center",color="#E45756",fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=.8); ax.axhline(50,ls=":",c="grey",lw=.8)
ax.text(-44,71,"pLDDT 70",fontsize=7,color="grey"); ax.text(-44,51,"pLDDT 50",fontsize=7,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("residues relative to the first P of PPPY"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_title("AlphaFold confidence around the PPPY motif in four Drosophila CG42404 orthologs\n(no AFDB model exists for D. melanogaster Q9VFA8)",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
